_comment: cloud-ci-dto-authz-trust gate policy (the CLASS-FIX for 'caller-supplied authorization trusted as the authz decision'; sibling of cloud-ci-authz-coverage / issue #770 / AUTH-005). R0 pack-shaped DATA — all repo-specifics live here, the Rust engine is neutral. The gate flags a function iff (a) it reads a caller-supplied authorization-decision field (a parameter whose type-name tail ends with an authorization_dto_type_suffix, OR its body reads a decision_field_ident off a binding, OR it reads an authorization_header_ident) AND (b) the only check is self-comparison/equality/membership against the request (a self_compare_token) AND (c) the body makes NO whole-token CALL to a pdp_decision_ident (.decide( / ensure_authorized / verify_principal / check_authz / ensure_authz). This is default-ALLOW-on-forged-input. The FIXED/GREEN pattern verifies a principal from an unforgeable credential and calls a server-side PDP decide()/ensure_authorized() port, failing closed (iam/ports/policy-cedar-api/src/authz.rs). Ratchets vs frozen_dto_authz_trust_instances (today's known instances) so the gate lands GREEN and only NEW instances block. SHRINK-ONLY + AUTOMATED: regenerate via the gate binary --write; growing requires --allow-new; a stale key self-cleans via DAT-STALE-BASELINE. Detection LIMITS (honest): keyed on the dominant corpus shape (a synchronous fn with an *Authorization DTO param that self-compares); a handler that hides the same self-comparison behind an opaque helper giving no authorization-DTO signal is outside the envelope (human review + the authz-coverage gate own that). Requiring an authorization-DTO/decision-field signal (not just any tenant_id compare) is what keeps benign tenant/path-binding validators (validate_tenant_binding / validate_path_body_binding) GREEN.
_frozen_baseline_note: Pre-existing caller-supplied-authorization-trust instances, FROZEN and keyed by stable <file>#<fn> signature. Each below is pre-existing debt owned by its capability team, grandfathered so the gate lands GREEN and blocks only NEW instances. Generated mechanically via the gate binary --write (shrink-only). REMEDIATION per instance: derive the principal from a verified mTLS/SVID/bearer credential, call the cloud-iam Cedar PDP server-side to decide(principal, action, resource), and fail closed — do NOT trust the caller-supplied authorization DTO/header as the verdict. The GREEN reference is iam/ports/policy-cedar-api/src/authz.rs (PrincipalVerifier::verify_principal + PublishAuthorizer::ensure_authorized / PDP decide() port). NOTE: iam/ports/policy-cedar-api/src/lib.rs#validate_authorization is itself a baselined instance — the #815/#816 fix added a NEW authz module (authz.rs) + REST edge that verifies a principal and calls a PDP, but the OLD port-level validate_authorization DTO-blob function remains and is its owner's residual remediation.

product_contract.born_blocking: Born-blocking vs a frozen baseline of currently-known caller-supplied-authz-trust instances. The FIXED iam/ports/policy-cedar-api/src/authz.rs PDP-port pattern is GREEN by construction. Pre-existing instances are frozen in frozen_dto_authz_trust_instances (shrink-only). Only a NEW instance blocks.
product_contract.pack_shaped: Neutral engine; every repo-specific is DATA in this file. A different repo adopts the gate by repointing the policy.
product_contract.fail_closed: No shell/network/VCS/clock/rand. A read-only walk of the candidate tree's Rust source. Malformed policy, gate-id mismatch, and a below-floor function census all fail closed.
product_contract.remediation_doctrine: iam/ports/policy-cedar-api/src/authz.rs (PrincipalVerifier::verify_principal on an unforgeable credential + PublishAuthorizer::ensure_authorized / PDP decide() port, fail-closed).
